metadata.short_desc: WhatsApp Web Gateway adapter with QR login.
metadata.desc: AstrBot platform adapter for WhatsApp Web/Baileys, backed by a local Gateway with QR login, DM/group access control, and media support.

gateway_host.hint: Keep 127.0.0.1 unless AstrBot and the Gateway run in different containers.

auto_start_gateway.hint: Starts the Node.js Gateway when the plugin page is opened. Platform instances have their own adapter config.

node_executable.hint: Node.js 20+ is recommended, for example node or /usr/bin/node.

auth_dir.hint: Empty means data/astrbot_plugin_whatsapp_adapter/whatsapp-auth under AstrBot's working directory.

dm_policy.hint: allowlist only allows allow_from; open requires allow_from to contain *; disabled rejects DMs.

allow_from.hint: Use E.164 numbers like +15551234567. Use * only if you intentionally accept all DMs.

group_policy.hint: allowlist checks group_allow_from or allow_from; open allows joined groups; disabled rejects groups.

groups.hint: Use WhatsApp group JIDs like 120363...@g.us. Use * to allow all groups.

group_allow_from.hint: Falls back to DM allowlist when empty.

command_prefix.hint: Prefix for WhatsApp slash commands, default /. e.g. /help triggers the registered help command.

register_commands.hint: When enabled, inbound messages matching registered CommandFilter names are marked as wake commands.

pre_ack_private.hint: When enabled, private messages auto-trigger a pre-ack emoji reaction.

pre_ack_public.hint: When enabled, group messages auto-trigger a pre-ack emoji reaction.

pre_ack_emojis.hint: WhatsApp emojis used for pre-ack reactions.

pre_ack_emoji.hint: When enabled, the bot sends a WhatsApp emoji reaction for each message received.

media_max_mb.hint: Maximum size per media file uploaded to the WhatsApp Gateway (MB).

typing_indicator.hint: When enabled, sends a composing presence before replying and restores available after sending.

mark_online.hint: Marks WhatsApp Web as online/available after connecting. Disable for invisible-style operation.

media_caption_mode.hint: separate=text and media sent separately; caption=text immediately before media becomes the caption.

link_preview_single_url.hint: Enable WhatsApp link preview only when a plain text message contains exactly one URL.

ignore_self_messages.hint: When enabled, messages where the sender JID matches the bot's own JID are ignored. Solves the same-number self-@mention and self-DM problem.

parse_inbound_formatting.hint: Convert inbound *bold* _italic_ ~strike~ ```code``` to Markdown for the LLM.

media_album_debounce_seconds.hint: Merge multiple images from the same sender within this window into one message; 0 disables. Default 2.5.

reaction_level.hint: off=no reactions; ack=pre-ack only; minimal=ack + conservative agent reactions; extensive=ack + encouraged agent reactions.

ack_reaction_emoji.hint: Emoji to use for the pre-ack reaction.

ack_reaction_direct.hint: When disabled, DMs will not auto-trigger a pre-ack emoji.

ack_reaction_group.hint: always=always ack in groups; mentions=only on @mentions/replies; never=no group ack.

remove_ack_after_reply.hint: When enabled, the pre-ack emoji is cleared after the bot sends its reply.

gateway_health_check_interval.hint: Background health check interval in seconds. Set to 0 to disable.

inbound_reaction_events.hint: Emit AstrBot events for emoji reactions on messages; disable to ignore reaction-only updates.

whatsapp-login.title: WhatsApp Login
whatsapp-login.description: View Gateway status, scan the WhatsApp Web QR code, restart the connection, or log out.
